newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE SHARES END FRIDAY ACTIVE BUT WEAKER.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE SHARES END FRIDAY ACTIVE BUT WEAKER.

text.p: Zimbabwe's industrial index lost a further 2.02 points to close at 10,022.24 on Friday, as lucrative interest rates on the local money market continued luring investors away from the bourse.
But the index gained 9.78 points on the week, largely due to a firmer start earlier in the week, which saw it gain 54.10 points on Tuesday.
"The market is still looking weak because interest rates on the money market are still expected to go up," one broker said.

The index was pressured down on Friday mainly by weaker deals in hotel giant Meikles which shed 25 cents to 2,550, while tobacco firm Rothmans tumbled 300 cents to 4,200 and cement group Circem lost 70 cents to 530.

In minings, gold giant Ashanti , coal producer Wankie, nickel firm Bindura and gold producer Falgold all traded at previous levels. The seven share index there was unchanged at 1,013.83 but however gained 4.78 points during the week.
